venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 8/1 (MOD Jk).** First Saturday of August beat target by 7.6% ($8,543 vs $7,941). Mid & opener held it down until closers arrived at 8pm. Keyshawn out sick so the kitchen closed early at 9pm — popcorn popped for late-night snacks. Kia Lacey started up at 9pm; down a barback but the team rallied with great attitude. Some broken glassware cleaned up quickly; a speaker possibly blew around 1am so music was kept low. Lots of late-night guests. Favorite moment: Yuvee back in after a month traveling. 317 guests / $26.95 check avg.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 8/1 (MOD KE, JMS).** Blowout Saturday, +41.6% over target ($15,231 vs $10,755) — first $15k night after a couple of sleepy weekends. Great early pop (~$2,500 before 7pm), plateau 7–9pm, then a full house from 9:30 through 12:30am. Annie rocked her first busy Saturday; John Michael ran support plus $500+ in food sales. DJ Derrick killed it. Repeat guests brought a group of ~12; met Randy Fox (friend of the New City folks) with high praise. Maintenance: walk-in freezer leaking. 86 NA beer. 518 guests / $29.40 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 8/1 (AM MJH & Josh / PM Carey & Lucas).** Strong Saturday, +19% over target ($19,842 vs $16,681). Busy night across all spaces as guests took refuge from the downtown Denver heat. DC/AM $1,447; D&C PM $18,395; Garden/6A $5,889 — Alex Vela's Garden debut, very smooth evening aside from an early dishwasher hiccup. Toast issues dwindling as the team gets dialed in. Kitchen chill with Rand and Dante ripping the dish pit. Highlight: Shawn Campbell's bachelor party brought lots of old faces in. Comps $614.01 (3.09%). 341 guests (Tock).

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 8/1 (MOD Kyler, Steves).** Beat target by 5.7% ($7,678 vs $7,264). Group-fueled open — 11 large parties vs only 6 solos — with a disco-cadence rhythm of fallows and pops; James managed the orchestration well. Full with a waitlist by 6:45pm, medium list through the night, slowed at 12:45am but half full at close. Celebrated an engagement, 3 birthdays, and hosted Amanda Byrne's October wedding-party tasting. 9 investor cocktails comped. Top sellers: Long Time Caller, Eight Limb Daiquiri, Cloudwalk. No-shows charged (Hoover 4-top, Eden 2-top). 253 covers / $30 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 8/1 (MOD Gigi/Joe & Josh/Saleh).** Net $11,753 vs target $11,732 (+0.2%) — squeaked past goal. 302 guests, $88.98 check avg; comps $328 (investors, DNLs, Raven/Griffin's parents, employee food, industry gifts). Food $2,011; SR $2,864 (food $469), Marquee $8,889 (food $1,542); no events. Slow start — local music festivals and a church procession blocked surrounding intersections. Gained traction ~8:45pm with a wave of reservations; mostly 2-tops made seating easy, no big waitlist. SR full most of night, closed at midnight with transfers to Marquee. One guest in line collapsed (intoxicated, fine — partner took them home). Kitchen: heavy fry night; Oscar's carrot cake for family meal. Maintenance: both restroom faucets, women's restroom door closing slowly. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 8/1 (MOD Cory / Jesse).** Just past goal (+1%, $8,823 vs $8,734). Marquee $8,598 / Garden only $225 — humid, mosquito-heavy Garden never filled and was closed at 10pm to focus on Marquee. Very busy first half; down a server but Grant and Devan never stopped moving, tight comms through several large parties. Lull at 10pm never recovered; broke point and cut at midnight, with bar stragglers carrying the night just past goal. James got creative in the kitchen despite low dish-ware. Maintenance: bar lights won't dim; service sink still draining poorly. 195 guests (80 covers / 115 walk-ins), $44.34 GCA.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 8/1 (AM Sam & Lex / PM Braden & Shannon/Drew).** Below target ($12,681 vs $14,500, −12.5%). Morning quiet before 10am, then strong 11–12 lunch with large parties (AM $2,583, 105 guests). Evening steady trickle with a 7pm rush, most tables sat but never full (PM $7,242, 218 guests). Sun Club ($849) closed early after an umbrella blew off the roof and down Broughton — no injuries or property damage. Hot Eye ($2,101) steady into a busy 10:30 pop and a proper party for Sam B.'s birthday. Kitchen smooth, no food sent back. Food sales $4,039.
